gross bytes created/day (main DB, Watchtower DB, shadow DB, logs, ArtifactStore -- delta between consecutive daily snapshots)

cleanup duration per run (recorded in each run's result JSON / ledger)

lock incidents (CleanupLeaseHeldError occurrences in cron logs)
